description: Reviewed boundaries for direct CSS length syntax (C18, owner 2026-11-08: every size from the size system; exceptions listed here). Static product geometry remains token-only; this file does not create design-token exceptions. tests/dimension-inventory.test.mjs fails on any length no rule here reviews; reviewed-deferred names the task that removes it.

rules.reason: The lexical occurrence is inside a source comment and cannot affect emitted CSS or runtime style.
This is an owned primitive, semantic token, breakpoint, or relative typography definition; consumers must reference it rather than repeat its value.
Vendored source is inventoried but is changed only through an owned adapter or an upstream update.
CSSOM and DOM measurements are expressed in CSS pixels by the browser and must retain their exact measured value.
The panel offset is derived from its current rendered height.

The phone ribbon's bottom sheet stops a step 1 under the field it fills (owner decision C62, prototypes/datepicker.html#lenta): the field's bottom edge is measured with getBoundingClientRect when the sheet opens, in CSS pixels, and is kept exact; the step itself is the space token.
The established accessibility preference stores an explicit CSS-pixel font size; changing its unit would change saved user settings.
Numeric legacy spinner options are documented CSS-pixel inputs; token or CSS-length strings remain the preferred declarative path.
The numeric animation-distance API is retained for SF5 compatibility and is serialized only at the Web Animations boundary.
The drawer's scroll-lock gutters and its bottom sheet's drag offset are derived from the current viewport, rendered boxes and the pointer.
Drag placeholders and transforms preserve the exact DOMRect and pointer position.
The notification stack (owner decision C50) places, clips and sizes from the toasts' rendered heights and the area's computed gap (--sf-space-1/2); the browser reports them in CSS pixels.
This policy names the lengths it reviews; nothing reads them as geometry.
The utilities' px step (basis-px, max-h-px): a one-pixel hairline, the C18 exception.
A zero length is the same in every unit and is no step of any ladder: a calc() base, a registered property's initial value, an offset of nothing.

C18 lists the 1-2px line as an exception: a border, a focus offset, a visually hidden 1px box, an anti-aliasing half pixel. A hairline marks an edge and keeps its pixel width at any root size (owner, 2026-10-10).

Owner decision C115 (layout L3a): the notice's actions go into the row from 36 / 48 rem (a toast 20 rem) of the notice's whole width. A container query reads the content box and cannot read a variable, so the step takes off the notice's frame as written lengths: its two inline paddings (1rem each, --sf-space-1) and its two borders (1px each, --sf-px).

Owner decision C88: in a column narrower than 360 px «Повторить» goes under the text of a failed file row. sf-file-download measures the same 22.5rem in script (js/error-fit.js NARROW_BELOW_REM); sf-file-preview's failed row reads it with a container query, which cannot read a variable.

A media or container query cannot read a variable, so its threshold is written in rem; it must be a step of the size scale (the breakpoints sm 32, md 44, lg 60, xl 72, xxl 80rem are steps) or one hair below one.
The breakpoint ladder for scripts (SF.breakpoints), the same rem steps the sheets switch at; queries are built from it.
Sass maps naming size steps by their rem value for container queries, which cannot read a variable (g6, h0, h2, h4, h6, h8, i0, i2).
WebKit zooms the page on focus of a field under 16 CSS pixels; the floor is in CSS px by the platform's rule.
The unit beside a quantity's number takes the same touch-phone floor the core gives the number (touch-field-zoom-floor), so the two stay one size (C53 D2).
Unit arithmetic converting one pixel to rem for the one-hair-below breakpoint; no length is emitted from these literals.
IntersectionObserver rootMargin takes px or % only; it is a look-ahead distance, not drawn geometry.
document.fonts.load needs a font shorthand with a size; the size is irrelevant to which glyphs load and is never drawn.
The copy fallback's textarea is moved off-screen; it is never seen.
Sized from the text around them by decision: inline code's room (C10, R024: .2em by .4em), an underline's offset. No ladder step is a fixed share of every text size.

Owner decision C136 (1): a text skeleton bar is as tall as the capitals of the text it stands for, Inter's capital height 0.727 em rounded to an even pixel with the size ladder's 2 px step, centred in the line (the glyph box's middle, 0.6055 em from its top). These are font metrics relative to the text, not sizes; the @supports test only asks whether round() parses.
Prose in a passport or manifest (summary, description, version notes) that quotes a measurement; no stylesheet or script reads it.
The minimal example's host markup (a host column of a given width); the component itself takes none of it.
Example and probe scaffolding: a host's width or height to test a breakpoint, a sentinel like 17px that proves a public variable is read. Not product geometry.
First-paint snapshots record what a template rendered (an attribute it was given, an inline transform of a slider track); the value is reviewed at its template or example.

A column or panel width passed as an attribute or a documented default (a popover 20rem = g0, a modal 48rem = h2, a field grid column 14rem = f4, a resizer's 12rem and 40rem bounds = f2 and h0): steps of the size scale written in rem where an attribute value is expected.

An in-place list (portal="false") takes the anchored list's height (owner remark R171): the room above or below its field, measured with getBoundingClientRect on opening less the panel's edge padding (a space token), in CSS pixels, written as --sf-dropdown-available-block-size.
Coordinates and sizes measured from the rendered page or the pointer (a floating panel's place, a drag ghost, a virtual list's spacer, a tooltip tail); the browser reports them in CSS pixels.
The dock threshold's default, 48rem (h2), a step of the size scale, and the comments that name it.

rules.task: C18 audit 2026-11-08 item 5: the legacy sf-system panel's px, em and colours move to space, radius, focus tokens and surface roles in one block with its colours (C18b)
rules.reason: The legacy low-vision panel styles itself inline in px and em relative to its own 16px reset; its sizes and its 71 colours are one look and change together.
The low-vision panel resets its own text to 16 CSS px so the page's chosen text size (specialkegl) never scales the panel's controls.
